summary: This bill requires the Director of the Bureau of Prisons to develop and implement a strategy to prevent fentanyl and other synthetic drugs from entering federal correctional facilities through postal mail by evaluating existing technologies, ensuring digital copies of mail are provided to inmates, and achieving 100 percent scanning capacity for incoming mail.

scores.thoughts: This bill is primarily focused on preventing fentanyl and other synthetic drugs from entering federal correctional facilities through mail. It mandates the development and implementation of a strategy to interdict these drugs, which directly relates to stricter drug enforcement within prisons.

The bill aims to enhance the security and safety of federal correctional facilities by preventing the smuggling of drugs, thereby contributing to stricter justice and stronger policing within the prison system. It also addresses the well-being of staff and inmates by reducing drug exposure.
